title: Debugging with the Scientific Method - Stuart Halloway
summary: Stuart Halloway of Cognitect argues for debugging with the scientific method: form hypotheses, try to falsify them, and write everything down. The talk is given to the Clojure community but applies to any language.
why: HN recommends it as a talk that changed how people debug, worth rewatching periodically.

quote.text: changed how I debug problems. I try to watch it once every year or two.
